_about: Display-only navigation changes (astro.config.mjs builds the sidebar from migration/nav-groups.json, which stays as it is). Article titles, routes and anchors do not change; every article stays in Browse all documentation, in search and at its address.

languageVersions._about: Shown as an Also in switch above each page (src/components/SourceHistory.astro), in place of the wiki's unsupported <languages/> marker. The /en and /es versions leave the sidebar; the switch and the browse page reach them.

folded._about: Two wiki pages with nearly the same title, listed once in the sidebar as a group.
